notes.title: Pause an app without losing its settings
notes.text: You can now turn an app off and keep its settings. Open the app under Apps and turn off Enabled. Turn it on again whenever you like.
Advanced under Settings is now called Developer, and your old links still work
Lists in the menu is now Dynamic lists and opens a page with all your lists

notes.title: Check GitHub and Cloudflare
notes.text: If you can’t save or publish, see whether GitHub and Cloudflare are working. Scroll to the bottom of the editor and tap System status. It checks only the services your website uses.
On a phone, the text toolbar takes up less room

notes.title: See your page as Google shows it
notes.text: The Google preview now looks like the real result on a phone and a computer, with your main keyword in bold. Open a page or blog post and look under Search engines.
Store connection is now on the Morpheme page under Settings

notes.title: See what’s new
notes.text: After each update, you now get a short summary of what’s new. You’ll find all the notes on the Morpheme page under Settings.
